design: 6 cases x 3 conditions x 2 fresh actors =36 attempts; order rotated prospectively, no model/effort override.2 known regression cases and4 newly authored reserved projects; no post-outcome case selection.
isolation: fork_turns:none, separate directories and scoped instructions; not OS-enforced isolation. Global platform skill metadata may remain. Each actor sees only one treatment/case.
runtime: Inherited model/effort; exact model version and token billing not available. Node25.6.1/Temurin25.0.3, target25. No external API evaluation service or global installation.
boundaries: Explicit loading tests execution, not automatic selection. No memory or multi-client experiment. Reviewer is independent of actor sessions; shared model biases remain.

resourceBudget.timeoutHandling: Stop an overrun, preserve partial output, classify it explicitly; do not count a timeout as a completed contract success.
